module_summary: Reservoir water-level controller: a 6-bit encoded Moore FSM tracks level band and rise/fall direction from three sensors and decodes flow-valve outputs.

anchors.name: lvl
anchors.why: Encoded level state (band plus rising/falling), drives all flow outputs

anchors.name: fr2
anchors.why: Flow output decoded from empty/lowest level state

anchors.name: fr1
anchors.why: Flow output asserted for low and empty level states

anchors.name: fr0
anchors.why: Flow output asserted for all states below full

anchors.name: dfr
anchors.why: Supplemental flow output when empty or level falling

anchors.name: low_pair
anchors.why: Decodes low-band states; shared by next-state and fr0/fr1 outputs

anchors.name: up_band
anchors.why: Decodes mid-band states for next-state and fr0 output

groups.name: Level FSM
groups.description: Encoded level/direction state machine updated from sensor inputs

groups.name: Output decoder
groups.description: Moore decode of state into flow-rate control outputs
